locations.note: The prologue: Tempest squad ambushed by Pax Armata at a NATO base in Georgia in September 2027, Murphy the only survivor.
Dagger squad retakes Gibraltar from Pax's occupation in March 2028. Iberian Offensive and Saints Quarter are multiplayer maps on the Rock and in the town.
The extraction of Fayek Selim from occupied Cairo, and the Egyptian tank push on the outskirts. Siege of Cairo is a multiplayer map.
New Sobek City: a multiplayer map in an invented desert city of the near future.
Dagger hunts the Pax cell in Brooklyn before the NATO summit, then fights for the President's motorcade. Manhattan Bridge and Empire State are multiplayer maps in the city.
The finale: the assault on Pax Armata's home base and its hypersonic missiles in Tajikistan. Liberation Peak, Mirak Valley and Operation Firestorm are multiplayer maps in the mountains.
Dagger raids Melissa Mills's home in McLean, Virginia, and learns who armed Pax.
Season 1, California Resistance: Blackwell Fields and Eastwood, multiplayer maps in Southern California.
Season 5, Siege of Las Vegas: the Vegas Strip and European Casino maps, from October 2026.
Area 51: a Season 5 map at the Nevada test site.

routes.name: Dylan Murphy and Dagger 1-3
routes.note: The sole survivor of a Pax Armata ambush in Georgia joins Dagger to retake Gibraltar, lose a defector in Cairo, save the President in Brooklyn, storm Pax's mountain base in Tajikistan and confront their CIA handler at home in Virginia.
